INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Alex and Jamie sit at a small table, coffees in hand. Alex looks tired, their shoulders slightly slumped. Jamie, oblivious to Alex's state, chats enthusiastically.

ALEX

JAMIE
(smiling)

JAMIE
(quickly)

ALEX

JAMIE
